title: Cloud KMS: keys, key rings and customer-managed encryption

videos.script: Cloud KMS does not encrypt your data. It encrypts the keys that encrypt your data. {{keys}} Every object gets its own key. That key is wrapped by a key that never leaves Google, and stored next to the data. {{envelope}} You will build that envelope on your own computer, with files standing in for Cloud KMS. Two orders, two key versions. {{practice}} Rotating adds a version. Old data stays readable through old versions. {{rotate}} Destroying a version is different. The data is still there, and nobody can ever read it again. That is why Cloud KMS waits thirty days before it does it. {{destroy}} Last, a plan that fails. A data source has to ask Google, even during a plan. {{plan}}
